text: `tmp-claude/2026-10-08-align-fixed-cost/mgy-db/tdb` is an mmseqs target db of 2,455,940 records, the target count of the 48-thread mgy run, built with the native mmseqs from the start of `nail-benchmarks/data/mgnify/mgy.0001.fa`. `time-align.sh` in the same directory times one `mmseqs align` call and prints the alignment count.
